newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsins rouble billionaires, worth over $200,000.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsins rouble billionaires, worth over $200,000.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin and his wife Naina are rouble billionaires worth more than $200,000, and the Russian leader earned the equivalent of $42,000 last year, Interfax news agency on Friday reported the Kremlin as declaring.
The delaration, part of Yeltsin's anti-corruption campaign requiring top officials to declare their wealth, would be published in the government newspaper Rossiiskiye Vesti on Saturday, it said.

The report says the Yeltsins own a large dacha country house outside Moscow on four hectares (10 acres) of land. They also own a 1995 BMW car which they valued at $12,000. They do not own any stocks or shares.
Their total wealth was 1.1 billion roubles ($207,000).
Yeltsin's presidential salary and savings bank interest earned him 243 million roubles ($42,000) in 1996. The interest was on funds Yeltsin earned from his two autobiographies, the report said.
The Yeltsins share their large Moscow apartment, which they do not own, with his younger daughter and her family, making a total of six in the Yeltsin home, the report said.

"I am convinced that voters have the right to know about the income and property of all top state officials," Yeltsin said earlier this month. He added that those who have a problem with that should just go.
